{{Short description|Andorran alpine skier (born 2000)}}

'''Cande Moreno''' (born 30 October 2000) is an Andorran [[Olympic Games|Olympic]] [[Alpine skiing|alpine skier]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Federation |first=International Ski and Snowboard |title=FIS {{!}} Cande MORENO - Athlete Biography - Alpine Skiing |url=https://www.fis-ski.com/DB/general/athlete-biography.html?sectorcode=al&competitorid=212707 |access-date=2026-03-14 |website=www.fis-ski.com |language=en}}</ref>

== Life and career ==
Moreno was born 30 October 2000 in [[Córdoba, Argentina|Córdoba]], Argentina.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Federation |first=International Ski and Snowboard |title=FIS {{!}} Cande MORENO - Athlete Biography - Alpine Skiing |url=https://www.fis-ski.com/DB/general/athlete-biography.html?sectorcode=al&competitorid=212707&type=result |access-date=2026-03-14 |website=www.fis-ski.com |language=en}}</ref>

She participated in the [[2022 Winter Olympics]], finishing 30th in the [[Alpine skiing at the 2026 Winter Olympics – Women's super-G|Super G, Women]], and 12th in the [[Alpine skiing at the 2022 Winter Olympics – Women's combined|Combined Women]] competitions.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Olympedia – Cande Moreno |url=https://www.olympedia.org/athletes/147811 |access-date=2026-03-14 |website=www.olympedia.org}}</ref>

During the [[2026 Winter Olympics opening ceremony|opening ceremony]] of the [[2026 Winter Olympics]], she was an Andorran flagbearer alongside [[Joan Verdú (alpine skier)|Joan Verdú]] and [[Irineu Esteve Altimiras|Irineu Esteve]].<ref>{{Cite web |title="Milano Cortina 2026 Opening Ceremony: All Flagbearers, all nations - complete list" |url=https://www.olympics.com/en/milano-cortina-2026/news/all-flagbearers-named-for-milano-cortina-2026-opening-ceremony}}</ref> She competed in the [[Alpine skiing at the 2026 Winter Olympics – Women's downhill|Downhill competition]], however she didn't finish after suffering a fall.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-02-08 |title=Cande Moreno Suffers Frightening Fall in Milano-Cortina Olympic Downhill Event |url=https://news-2026.twaslnews.com/238352/ |access-date=2026-03-14 |language=ar}}</ref>
